facts.fact: 这是 Simone 播报的岛上活动广告，介绍夏令营主题的各项冒险活动。
facts.anchor: This is Simone, here to hype another list of fantastic adventures, so take a break and listen up.

facts.fact: 从现在到深夜，工作人员在 Angelfish Inlet 举办夏令营主题活动。
facts.anchor: From now until late tonight, our staff is hosting a summer-camp themed event at Angelfish Inlet.

facts.fact: 游客可从码头划皮划艇沿 Palmera 运河游览，该运河位于 Thrill Harbor 与 Tranquil Cove 之间。
facts.anchor: you can launch off the docks in your very own kayak and paddle down the Palmera Canal, which runs between Thrill Harbor and Tranquil Cove.

facts.fact: 场内有富有挑战性的绳索课程，考验敏捷与平衡。
facts.anchor: There is a challenging ropes course that will test your agility and balance.

facts.fact: 射箭场有友好比赛，获胜者可获得神秘大奖。
facts.anchor: At the archery range, there’s a friendly competition where the winner will take home an awesome mystery prize.

facts.fact: Thrill Harbor 的烟花表演今晚九点半在 Iguana Beach 开始。
facts.anchor: The breathtaking show starts at nine-thirty p.m. at Iguana Beach.

facts.fact: 炎热指数上升，将在下午两点到三点间达到峰值，提醒补水与避暑。
facts.anchor: the heat index is on the rise and will peak between two and three p.m.
